pages.text: The three main bases near your spawn are guarded by heroes under Amun's hold: $(l)Abathur$() at the zerg lair, $(l)Swann$() at the terran base, $(l)Karax$() at the protoss base. They wait in the $(l)great hall$() at the bottom of the levels under their base: tunnels wide enough for an army, with rooms and guards — flesh and creep for the zerg, technical tunnels with pipes for the terrans, hidden temples for the protoss. The way down opens on the base's east side.$(br2)Beaten, a guardian does not die: Amun's hold breaks, it tells you how Amun held it and its troops, and it goes over to you with its whole base and army.

A threatened guardian calls its base's army to it. $(l)Karax$() sends air drones and warps in photon cannons for a while; at 2/3 health he raises two $(l)khaydarin monoliths$() that shoot from afar through up to 3 blocks (break the crystal on top); at 1/3 the Spear of Adun's $(l)purifier beam$() follows you, cutting blocks — run.$(br2)$(l)Swann$() fires grenades and lays $(l)mines$() that blow up 5 blocks round; at 2/3 he sets up $(l)flaming Betties$(); at 1/3 he climbs into $(l)Odin$(), whose barrage breaks blocks and who once drops a nuke — leave the red dot.$(br2)$(l)Abathur$() lays toxic nests (seen a moment, then only by a detector), evolves his units, roots you with tentacles; his hall's creep tumors heal him — burn them. At 1/3 he becomes a leaping $(l)brutalisk$() with a symbiote and sheds a copy of himself; Karax flies a low $(l)archive guardian$(). The great forms break the blocks in their way.

Only then does its race's ship come to the stratosphere (the leviathan after Abathur, the Hyperion after Swann, the mothership after Karax), and a $(l)heroic transport$() waits by the guardian — an overlord, a medivac or a warp prism, marked on your minimap. Click it with the command panel: it lifts you into the sky, into the stratosphere, to the $(l)hangar under the ship$(), and waits there. Click it again to go back down. Order it with the command panel to wait elsewhere.
